verdict.rationale: Sentry documents an official CLI at docs.sentry.io/cli, confirmed by a probe, though it is described as mainly for debug information files, releases, source maps and code mappings. For the AI-native angle, Sentry offers a one-command `npx @sentry/ai install` that teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Grok to install and configure Sentry. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI supports agent-oriented workflows such as querying or triaging issues with machine-readable output, depth beyond release and debug-file management, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
